title: Delbert Again

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: So you aced the new members part of the initiation. I'm impressed, Cosmo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you aced the new members part of the initiation. I'm impressed, Cosmo.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: You had to ask that Basin punk though? Kid's a walking disaster zone. He managed to burn down the level six inspection hab.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You had to ask that Basin punk though? Kid's a walking disaster zone. He managed to burn down the level six inspection hab.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Level six is underwater.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Level six is underwater.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Hmph. If he's willing to lay down his life for O.R.S, then O.R.S will take him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmph. If he's willing to lay down his life for O.R.S, then O.R.S will take him.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Yeah, as a last resort. But if he's willing to lay down his life for O.R.S, then O.R.S will stand by him. For the good of the Rig.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, as a last resort. But if he's willing to lay down his life for O.R.S, then O.R.S will stand by him. For the good of the Rig.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Now that we have members we can act. We can make a statement. Make the city stand up and tune their aural augs to our voices.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now that we have members we can act. We can make a statement. Make the city stand up and tune their aural augs to our voices.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Something explosive. Something drastic. We’re gonna put out… a press release.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something explosive. Something drastic. We’re gonna put out… a press release.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: We will blow up their minds with a bomb of truth. Sending out fragments of poetry to lodge in the hearts of the Nivalians.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We will blow up their minds with a bomb of truth. Sending out fragments of poetry to lodge in the hearts of the Nivalians.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: First, we will need a headline. Something incendiary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: First, we will need a headline. Something incendiary.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Disarming scansion. I like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Disarming scansion. I like it.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Banal, but acceptable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Banal, but acceptable.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: YES. A proclamation. A call to action.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: YES. A proclamation. A call to action.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Next, we’ll need an image. Something inspiring.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Next, we’ll need an image. Something inspiring.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Good. Last, we’ll need to make people look at the Rig itself. Open their eyes to what’s in front of them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. Last, we’ll need to make people look at the Rig itself. Open their eyes to what’s in front of them.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Yes. Art to illuminate the structural beauty of the Rig.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Art to illuminate the structural beauty of the Rig.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Sending a message in the lifeblood of the city. I like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sending a message in the lifeblood of the city. I like it.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Well done, Cosmo. This is the start of a new era. Just watch, with our members' help, O.R.S. will change it all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well done, Cosmo. This is the start of a new era. Just watch, with our members' help, O.R.S. will change it all.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: You and me, none of us... would ever get close to making this happen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You and me, none of us... would ever get close to making this happen.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Could happen to anyone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could happen to anyone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, you gave me his name, so ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you gave me his name, so ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, you gave me his name, so ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, you gave me his name, so ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look, all he needs is a bit of guidance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, all he needs is a bit of guidance.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look, all he needs is a bit of guidance.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look, all he needs is a bit of guidance.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: About the laying down of life thing…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About the laying down of life thing…
pronounText.TextSheVersion: About the laying down of life thing…
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: About the laying down of life thing…

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you have in mind?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you have in mind?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you have in mind?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, that's better than blowing something up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that's better than blowing something up.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, that's better than blowing something up.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, that's better than blowing something up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Poetry again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Poetry again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Free the Oil Rig?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Free the Oil Rig?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Riggy Riggy Let's Get Jiggy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Riggy Riggy Let's Get Jiggy?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: RIG MUST LIVE.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: RIG MUST LIVE.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We have Sanya on board, the photographer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We have Sanya on board, the photographer.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We have Sanya on board, the photographer.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We have Sanya on board, the photographer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess I can do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess I can do that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess I can do that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I reckon that’s Reena’s field.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I reckon that’s Reena’s field.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe Botan could… make something explode?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe Botan could… make something explode?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe Botan could… make something explode?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe Botan could… make something explode?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok. I might know someone. Works with neon signs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok. I might know someone. Works with neon signs.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ok. I might know someone. Works with neon signs.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ok. I might know someone. Works with neon signs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's do it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yep, exactly that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yep, exactly that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds bad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds bad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Attention is everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Attention is everything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cool.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cool.

/// spawn rig must live headline
DelbertCherry.Business +=1;
